nodes.name: document.rs
nodes.summary: Provides a helper function for creating HTML elements in the context of contenteditable document operations.

nodes.name: element.rs
nodes.summary: Provides contenteditable element analysis including resolved display values, specified command values, modifiable element detection, inline container classification, and tag name manipulation.

nodes.name: htmlelement.rs
nodes.summary: Provides HTML element utilities including local name extraction, text decoration value removal, value clearing on elements, and contenteditable focus state management.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting all contenteditable helper modules (document, element, node, range, selection, text) for the contenteditable subsystem.

nodes.name: node.rs
nodes.summary: Core contenteditable DOM manipulation module providing node splitting, wrapping, value pushing/forcing, whitespace canonicalization, tree restructuring, and command value resolution across the editable tree.

nodes.name: range.rs
nodes.summary: Provides contenteditable range helpers including effective containment detection, block extension, and recording/restoring formatting states and values during DOM mutations.

nodes.name: selection.rs
nodes.summary: Provides selection-level operations including point equivalence resolution, deletion with block merging and wrapper stripping, and value setting across the selection range.

nodes.name: text.rs
nodes.summary: Provides text node analysis including data retrieval, whitespace detection, collapsed whitespace identification, and whitespace preservation inheritance checks.

nodes.name: execcommands.rs
nodes.summary: Top-level execCommand dispatch implementing Document.execCommand(), queryCommandSupported(), queryCommandEnabled(), queryCommandState(), queryCommandValue(), and queryCommandIndeterminate() with argument mapping, support verification, and enablement checks.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting the base command infrastructure, all command handlers, contenteditable helpers, and the execCommand dispatch entry point as a single module.
